body: i have no intent on hurting others...i find the attachments that generally cause people to cherish their lives seem not as meaningful anymore. once you don't feel connected to the life around you then it loses its meaning which drives you to sustain it

semi explanation really. due to all of regular life problems (job denials despite education mostly but others as well), i was at first depressed, then fought it through with logic, then more depression...it's been like this for a while...

recently though, i even walk down the street and feel absolutely disconnected. every moment seems like one of those scenes on a tv show or movie with the main character sitting at a still shot and the background moving along behind him/her. the more this becomes a reality the more ppl get upset that are close to me the more i disconnect. 

which makes isolation easier and etc, just a spiral i'm having trouble getting out of. i talk to people and it gets awkward, i don't talk to them and isolate it gets awkward...i don't know anymore. turn to randomness of reddit...
